data.long_meaning: Gabriana is a feminine form of the name Gabriel, which in Hebrew means 'God is my strength'. In the Bible, the archangel Gabriel appeared to the prophet Daniel to explain the future. The name Gabriana carries the meaning “God's strong woman” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Gabriana usually hope their child will grow to embody god's strong woman and live with faith, good character and purpose.
